g.text: From Research Idea to Fielded Research Tools
One Research Setting · Different Respondent Groups · Coordinated Survey and Semi-Structured Interviews
One setting, one inquiry, different roles
Define what must be explained first;
then decide who can provide each kind of evidence.
Grouped by role and information advantage
Kept in Word / interviewer record forms
Default: different respondent groups in one setting; one person need not complete both tools
